prompt: Red finds a lost puppy in the park
title: Lost Puppy
irony: Red tries to keep the found puppy by hiding it, which keeps it lost, so only giving it back keeps it as a friend.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Warm park swings sway empty while a small wet puppy whimpers under the red slide.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Red grabs the loose leash and plots to keep the puppy secret while Green checks its muddy paws.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares Red to hide the puppy and it bolts into the dark bushes as Navy calls softly.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids gather round the shivering puppy and chant for the lost puppy together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Red hides the puppy behind the bench while Jade's wild chase sends it zooming off with one shoe.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The kids corner the puppy by the fountain and it shakes cold water all over Black's tall tale.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The soggy kids hug the shivering puppy close and chant for the lost puppy again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: White kneels by the shaking puppy and sees that fixing alone is not enough.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White decides to post bright signs and walk the puppy home while Red agrees to share.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crew posts signs everywhere and White sings that giving back keeps a friend.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The gang chants the hook while Navy hugs his found puppy and Red gains daily visits.
